rules: Session A is 9:00 AM – 12:00 PM and Session B is 1:30 PM – 4:30 PM.
You will not be allowed into the examination hall after the prescribed time.

Strictly prohibited inside the Vivekanand Lecture Hall Complex (VLHC) during the exam: mobile phones, personal bags or handbags, study material (books, notes, loose papers), palmtops and electronic gadgets, scientific or programmable calculators with memory, and any course material written or stored on slips, calculator covers, clipboards or body parts.
Do not bring mobile phones or bags to the exam centre, not even to leave at the entrance or the gate of the hall.
Check that no prohibited material is on or around your seat before the exam starts. If any is found, that paper is cancelled and disciplinary action follows.
Follow the instructions displayed at the venue and any notices from the Examination Section.

PwD candidates get 20 extra minutes per hour (60 minutes for an end-semester paper), may use a lamp and magnifying glass, and get large-font papers if they have low vision. Room G-6 is set aside for them if needed.
Students with an infectious disease who wish to appear write in isolation in room G5; students using a scribe write in G6. For 5th semester Minor Degree papers, both write in G6.
